texts: Our team has created a unique algorithm to analyze your journal entries, helping you understand your thoughts and emotions more deeply. The model is trained on open data and cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) materials.
Here are a few tips to help you get the most out of your analysis:
Describe not only the events but also your emotions and thoughts about what happened. Remember: the more detailed your entry, the more helpful the analysis will be.
Try to focus on one specific situation or thought. If several significant events happen during the day, it’s easier to create separate entries for each of them.
The algorithm helps identify unhelpful beliefs, but don’t hesitate to also note positive moments — this is important for balance and growth.

mockGpt.consolation: Sometimes we give more weight to other people’s words and reactions than they deserve. Mistakes at work happen to everyone and don’t reflect your value as a professional or as a person. You have achievements, strengths, and experiences that speak to your professional and personal worth.
solutions: Try to distinguish constructive feedback about your work from a judgment of your personality. It’s possible your boss was simply focusing on the task, which is a natural part of the work process.
Recall your past successes and moments when you handled tasks well. This will help you see the situation more broadly and avoid drawing conclusions based on a single episode.
Work on building your self-esteem. The more confident you feel, the easier it will be to take feedback without feeling like it is a personal criticism.
mockGpt.distortion: Selected due to overgeneralization: applying a single instance (a mistake at work) to your overall self-perception (“everyone thinks I’m a failure”).
mockGpt.negativeThought: I feel like everyone around me thinks I’m a failure.
mockGpt.adaptiveResponse: One mistake does not define me as a professional or as a person. I can learn from these situations by relying on my skills and past successes.

mockGptDream.common: A dream can reflect an internal journey through fears, intense feelings, and hidden desires. The atmosphere of a castle, a stormy sea, and destruction may symbolize feelings of instability and deep emotional processes. Such themes are often linked to the mind’s attempt to process internal conflicts and move toward self-exploration.
symbols: 🏰 Castle: A symbol of safety, autonomy, and boundaries. It may reflect your desire for protection and personal space.
🌊 Stormy sea: An image of intense emotions, internal turmoil, and change.
🔮 Large mirror: A symbol of self-discovery, connecting with your true self, and internal reflection.
transfer: 🧑‍💼 A changing reflection in the mirror may suggest a search for authentic identity and a desire to better understand your inner qualities.
🏰 The castle may symbolize protection and personal boundaries, while its destruction could represent a fear of losing them or significant changes that cause tension.
🌊 An intensifying sea storm may reflect rising emotions and distress, as well as a fear of facing things that are hard to control.
mockGptDream.desires: A wish to better understand your deeper emotions and to find inner clarity and stability.
mockGptDream.fears: Fear of change and uncertainty, and anxiety about losing control and stability.
mockGptDream.middle: I want to feel stable and safe in my life.
mockGptDream.deep: Sometimes I fear that intense emotions might get out of control, so I want to be prepared for change and strengthen my inner resilience.
mockGptDream.conclusion: This dream may reflect internal processes related to the search for stability, self-understanding, and adaptation to change. Your mind is attempting to process experiences and integrate new internal insights.
